speaker: ziqi
text: In the early days of my fieldwork, I wanted to introduce Harie through a five-senses map.

speaker: ziqi
text: The programming I learned as a child—I never thought it would come in handy here.

speaker: ziqi
text: I wanted to share the results of my research with more people through a web mini-game.

speaker: ziqi
text: It was certainly difficult at first.

speaker: ziqi
text: I hadn't used it in a long time, and had almost forgotten everything.

speaker: ziqi
text: But JavaScript is a mainstream language, and getting started or putting it into practice isn't that hard.

speaker: ziqi
text: Thanks to the foundations I had, relearning went smoothly, and I found my pace with development.

speaker: ziqi
text: While making the game, I realized something more important than just "introducing Harie."

speaker: ziqi
text: It was "understanding Harie itself through the culture that makes Harie, Harie."

speaker: ziqi
text: So I changed my goal. Rather than simply introducing the place,

speaker: ziqi
text: I wanted players to understand through experience, and to think about themselves.

speaker: ziqi
text: A region is, in the end, just a region.

speaker: ziqi
text: Just a piece of land.

speaker: ziqi
text: It only becomes a living place when people dwell there.

speaker: ziqi
text: "Fallen leaves return to the root—one always yearns for home."

speaker: ziqi
text: That is a feeling I've always carried—it's the very thing I said in the end.

speaker: ziqi
text: "Where do you live, and where do you wish to return?"

speaker: ziqi
text: I come from Nanjing, a big city,

speaker: ziqi
text: So having the chance to experience agriculture firsthand, like this time, was precious.

speaker: ziqi
